description: This Java class defines configuration properties for protocol adapters in the Eclipse Hono project, including settings for authentication, vendor properties, default values, connection limits, and tenant timeout durations.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A Java class extending ServiceConfigProperties that encapsulates configuration settings for Hono protocol adapters, such as authentication requirements, vendor property inclusion, default value usage, connection limits, and tenant timeout durations.

methods.name: isAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Returns whether device authentication is required for the protocol adapter.

methods.name: setAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the protocol adapter should require device authentication.

methods.name: isJmsVendorPropsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if vendor properties are included in downstream messages.

methods.name: setJmsVendorPropsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables inclusion of vendor properties in messages.

methods.name: isDefaultsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if default device values are used to augment messages.

methods.name: setDefaultsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables use of default device values.

methods.name: getEventLoopBlockedCheckTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout for protocol adapter liveness checks.

methods.name: setEventLoopBlockedCheckTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for protocol adapter liveness checks.

methods.name: getMaxConnections
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

methods.name: setMaxConnections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent connections.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a connection limit has been set.

methods.name: getTenantIdleTimeout
methods.description: Gets the duration after which an idle tenant times out.

methods.name: setTenantIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the tenant idle timeout duration.
